run_tridentnet_training: run the TridentNet training script with a config file and GPU count via command line
run_tridentnet_evaluation: run the TridentNet model in eval_only mode to test on a COCO dataset
build_trainer_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator for the TridentNet Trainer class with a specified dataset name
setup_tridentnet_config: setup the TridentNet configuration by merging a config file and command line options
resume_tridentnet_training: resume TridentNet training from a checkpoint using the DetectionCheckpointer and Trainer
